achievements.name: First Voyage
achievements.detail: Complete Captain Leeway's first story mission and take the submarine out onto the Great Sea.

achievements.name: Bank Shot
achievements.detail: Defeat an enemy with a bullet that bounces off a surface before it hits.

achievements.name: Fancy Hat
achievements.detail: Shoot an enemy's hat off, pick it up, and finish the mission so the hat stays collected.

achievements.name: New Hand
achievements.detail: Recruit a crew member at an ocean bar and bring that bot on a later mission.

achievements.name: New Job
achievements.detail: Change a crew member's job by equipping a different kind of weapon, then field them in that role.

achievements.name: Deeper Waters
achievements.detail: Install a submarine upgrade and use it to enter a region of the Great Sea that was out of reach.

achievements.name: Ship to Ship
achievements.detail: Win a real-time battle against an enemy vessel while sailing the sea map.

achievements.name: Clean Sweep
achievements.detail: Finish a heist after picking up all of the loot waiting inside it.

achievements.name: Full Crew
achievements.detail: Finish a mission with every crew member you deployed still standing.

achievements.name: Mixed Squad
achievements.detail: Start a mission with crew members assigned to three different jobs.

achievements.name: Seasoned Bot
achievements.detail: Raise any crew member's level with experience earned on missions.

achievements.name: Last Heading
achievements.detail: Finish the campaign's last story mission.
